name: monero
description: Monero node and wallets over REST and MCP: sync state, blocks, transactions, wallet balances and addresses, and transfers.

monero_url.title: docker-monero URL
monero_url.description: Base URL of your running docker-monero instance, for example http://localhost:8080. The REST API lives under /v1 and MCP at /mcp.

monero_token.title: docker-monero API token
monero_token.description: Bearer token, the value of DOCKER_MONERO_API_TOKEN on the server. Every API and MCP call needs it.
